_note: Scenario and action EFFECTS are no longer hand-set constants: they are the median feature-space deltas from SIMULATED simulator counterfactuals in data/synthetic/recovery/recovery_scenario_matrix.csv (scripts/synthetic/generate_recovery.py). This file keeps labels, input floors and the intervention-burden policy weights. Lost hours are re-derived from availability.

NORMAL.description: Current operating state, no additional disruption.

HEAVY_RAIN.description: Monsoon week at the REAL IMD 95th-percentile 7-day rainfall (mine cell, 2021-2025); wet ground, haul-road slowdown.

HAULAGE_DISRUPTION.description: Haul-road damage (+40 % cycle time) and 4 fewer trucks (simulated).

COMBINED_DISRUPTION.description: Heavy rain + equipment degradation + blast delay together (simulated).

EQUIPMENT_RECOVERY.label: Equipment recovery (standby crew / critical spares: repair time x0.4)

SCHEDULE_ADJUSTMENT.label: Schedule adjustment (redeploy +3 trucks, re-sequence benches: haul cycle x0.9)

BLAST_DRILL_DELAY_REDUCTION.label: Blast / drill delay reduction (pre-positioned explosives, drill spares, wet-hole mitigation)

intervention_burden._note: PROJECT DECISION-POLICY WEIGHTS, not industry cost data. Equal weights: each intervention counts as one unit of planning/crew/coordination effort. Used only as a tie-break after residual-gap objectives are equivalent within tolerance.
